about: The tractus of the formulary “Quinquagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Sing joyfully to God, all the earth; serve the Lord with gladness. Enter into His presence with rejoicing; know that the Lord Himself is God. He made us, and we did not make ourselves; but we are His people and the sheep of His pasture.

alignments.gloss: and we did not make ourselves

w027.explanation: Nos can be read as accusative with an understood fecimus: He made us, not we ourselves. A nominative reading with ipsi as an intensified subject is also possible. Without the expressed verb, the form alone does not decide the case.
